analysis.title: Higher for Longer, Stronger for Longer
key_insights: The USD bid has run for a 4th consecutive day. Markets price a cumulative ~48bps for the December plus January FOMC meetings, which the desk says matches UBS Economics' view of two consecutive hikes.
SOFR whites repriced sharply over the last two weeks, with the reds and greens shifting up in parallel to where markets traded about a month ago.
SOFR pricing temporarily decoupled from the US growth impulse and traded in tandem with oil.
October PPI is expected later today at +6.6% y/y for final demand and +5.0% for ex food and energy, both new post-2022 highs. The final demand increase is concentrated in goods, mainly energy.
The desk says the recent rates rout has likely reached a pause. SOFR rates vol uncertainty is at levels comparable to prior bouts of uncertainty.

Canada: USDCAD has traded in a 1.39 to 1.43 range for most of the year. The desk expects a grind past 1.43 if the CAD inflation print undershoots estimates, because the rate differential gap is the widest all year and likely widens further.

Eurozone: 3Q26 GDP confirmed the initial +0.4% reading, +1.3% y/y. EURUSD did not break 1.10 but moved decisively through 1.11, and is the sharpest laggard on medium-term trend strength and quality among G10.
